Great eats and nice people
Oct 2026 • Solo
I had a very nice time here. The staff were very knowledgeable on the dishes and when I had something a bit more specific to Vietnam, they took the time to show me how to properly eat it. The service was great, they were very attentive. It's a pretty central location in the city, so if you're in D1, it's a must have spot. The food itself was fresh and came out right as it was done. It was fairly quick, especially since they made it to order, so I had no issue with waiting slightly longer than I would got fast food. When I come back to Vietnam, I'm definitely coming back here!
